That resulted in the payment applying to a different ledger bucket on our side and left a EUR 12,400 balance on your AR. Can you confirm whether the second VAT line is an internal posting (e.g. reverse charge) that should have been excluded from customer billing?

Attached: invoice-8234.pdf (pdf)

Elena — thanks for flagging and sorry for the disruption.

Quick summary from our side: invoice 8234 was issued for your Dedicated plan subscription plus a one-time onboarding service. The onboarding stub should have been billed net with a reverse-charge (CloudMesh EU entity), but an earlier billing rule duplicated VAT as a customer-charge line and as a reverse-charge control line. That duplication would indeed present locally as an extra tax line we don't expect customers to pay.

I’ve looped in Marcus (Revenue) and Naomi (AR) to confirm the ledger mapping and to propose a short journal correction to net out the duplicate VAT so your payment can be applied in full.

Next steps (proposed):
- Marcus to confirm revenue recognition impact and whether this needs a revmap adjustment.
- Naomi to prepare an AR journal to reclass the EUR 12,400 duplicate VAT to a contra-tax account.
- We’ll share a corrected invoice PDF and the journal CSV for your records.

Can you confirm if CloudMesh can accept a corrected invoice + signed confirmation rather than a credit memo? I want to avoid a long credit/collection cycle.

—Jonas
Head of Partnerships (covering billing escalations)
Redwood Inference
